expanded_source_archive.format: tar.xz; complete original member contents expanded under per-package namespaces
expanded_source_archive.tree_digest: SHA-256 over original archive member order, one UTF-8 JSON line per member; sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True; keys: path,type,mode,size,linkname,payload_sha256. mode is permission bits (original mode & 07777), with file type recorded separately, because standard tar writers strip redundant file-type bits from the mode header. Original archive member path and original linkname are used; payload_sha256 is SHA-256 of regular-file bytes, otherwise null.
